title: This Shark Swallowed the Infinity Gauntlet
description: Jeff the Land Shark just wanted to cool off during a heat wave. It ends with an X-ray nobody at the clinic was ready for.
hook_note: Opens on a tiny sweating shark melting on the kitchen floor - instantly adorable and instantly a problem.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.line: This is Jeff the Land Shark, and today the GOAT is melting.

segments.text: This is Jeff the Land Shark, and today the GOAT is melting.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.line: A heat wave is cooking him alive, and he needs somewhere cold, fast.

segments.text: A heat wave is cooking him alive, and he needs somewhere cold, fast.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.line: Which is when he spots the coldest place in the house.

segments.text: Which is when he spots the coldest place in the house.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.line: His eyes literally turn to snowflakes, and Jeff moves in, zero hesitation.

segments.text: His eyes literally turn to snowflakes, and Jeff moves in, zero hesitation.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.line: Enter Kate Bishop, his long-suffering owner, who walks into a crime scene,

segments.text: Enter Kate Bishop, his long-suffering owner, who walks into a crime scene,

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.line: and finds one freeloading shark fast asleep inside her fridge.

segments.text: and finds one freeloading shark fast asleep inside her fridge.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.line: Kate lays down the law: the fridge is now off-limits.

segments.text: Kate lays down the law: the fridge is now off-limits.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.line: Out back, Jeff finds a pool, and a hose to fill it with.

segments.text: Out back, Jeff finds a pool, and a hose to fill it with.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.line: Only for the little menace to chomp straight through it.

segments.text: Only for the little menace to chomp straight through it.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.line: So Jeff does what champions do, and calls in a favor.

segments.text: So Jeff does what champions do, and calls in a favor.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.line: Enter Iceman, the most clutch X-Man alive, who buries the whole yard in snow.

segments.text: Enter Iceman, the most clutch X-Man alive, who buries the whole yard in snow.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.line: And Jeff gets the best day of his life, snow angels included.

segments.text: And Jeff gets the best day of his life, snow angels included.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.line: That night, however, Jeff's stomach starts making sounds a stomach should not make,

segments.text: That night, however, Jeff's stomach starts making sounds a stomach should not make,

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.line: and Kate finds him down bad on the floor, bundles him up, and bolts for the clinic.

segments.text: and Kate finds him down bad on the floor, bundles him up, and bolts for the clinic.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.line: One very confused doctor finds nothing, so they take an X-ray.

segments.text: One very confused doctor finds nothing, so they take an X-ray.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.line: Inside is a donut, a burger, a license plate,

segments.text: Inside is a donut, a burger, a license plate,

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.line: and the motherfucking Infinity Gauntlet.
shots.emotion: slow deadpan astonishment, savoring every word

segments.text: and the motherfucking Infinity Gauntlet.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.line: Kate facepalms and hits him with the full government name: 'JEFFREY!'

segments.text: Kate facepalms and hits him with the full government name: 'JEFFREY! '

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.line: She still feels bad for the little guy, so she builds Jeff his own house.

segments.text: She still feels bad for the little guy, so she builds Jeff his own house.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.line: He moves in, parks on the welcome mat, and invites Kate over.

segments.text: He moves in, parks on the welcome mat, and invites Kate over.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.line: And the second she peeks inside, Jeff punts her straight through the door,

segments.text: And the second she peeks inside, Jeff punts her straight through the door,

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.line: leaving her stuck in the doghouse while the GOAT sips a tropical drink. No notes.

segments.text: leaving her stuck in the doghouse while the GOAT sips a tropical drink. No notes.
